about: English names for Knesset factions (Knesset database, KNS_Faction), by their exact recorded Hebrew name. A faction formed at the opening of a term by a list's elected members is shown under that list's name; every other faction is shown under its own recorded name, and this map gives the English of that same name (audit 12 Nov 2026, fx-names). Used on MK history cards and the seat cards (scripts/mk-history-runtime.ts) and in generated research-event summaries (scripts/research/build-faction-events.py). Exact Hebrew-name entries take precedence in research summaries so joint factions retain all named components. A plain translation or transliteration of the whole Hebrew name, partners and 'led by …' included; an acronym followed by its own spelled-out name (בל״ד - ברית לאומית דמוקרטית) is given the party's established English name (Balad, Hadash, Ra'am, Ta'al, Telem). Display names, not facts: the Hebrew name stays authoritative and is what the card shows in Hebrew.

sameNameAbout: One English name for factions whose Hebrew name in the Knesset database is exactly the key, in every Knesset (audit cx-factions-07, 12 Nov 2026). Without it the name follows each election's list label, so the same Hebrew name showed as "UTJ" in the 13th to 15th Knessets and "United Torah Judaism" in the 20th, 21st and 25th, and the 23rd Knesset's הבית היהודי as "The Jewish Home" beside "Jewish Home" in every other Knesset. Overrides every other naming rule for these factions; the Hebrew shown is unchanged.
